request: Summarize Daniel's mail about the workshop and reply that I'll give the opening talk.

mails.subject: Workshop on research software
mails.body:
Dear Sofia,

We are organising a one-day workshop on research software on Friday 4 December in the Senate Room. Registration closes on 27 November. Would you give the opening talk at 9:30?

Best regards,
Daniel

mails.subject: Library opening hours in December
mails.body:
Dear reader,

From 1 December the library opens at 8:00 and closes at 22:00 on weekdays.

University Library
